heading_path: Part 9—Removal of trade mark from Register for nonuse
9.23  Removal of trade mark from register
text: If the Registrar dismisses the opposition under regulation 9.10, the Registrar must remove the trade mark from the Register in respect of the goods, services, or both, specified in the application for removal.
